messages:
Mira (Product): dropped a compact mock for the Audit export modal — hoping for quick UX + security + a11y sweep before we freeze labels.
Sam (Design): quick pass: rename 'Presets' -> 'Saved views' for clarity; retention dropdown is crowded, consider grouping by default buckets (30/90/365) and an 'Custom' entry.
Matt (Eng): note: CSV export currently uses headers `timestamp,event_type,actor,resource,region,retention_days`. Changing visible labels will break some customer parsers. We can add a small `export_manifest.json` next to CSV with header aliases.
Elaine (Security): must show explicit guidance if KMS key IDs or aliases are included: "Export contains key metadata. Verify destination meets export controls and retention policies." Also require an audit event when a user opts into key metadata.
Aria (A11y): a11y checklist: 1) saved views list keyboard operable (tab + arrow); 2) filter chips need `role=button` + `aria-pressed`; 3) when export begins announce "Export started" and keep SR updated via `aria-live=polite`.
Sam (Design): tiny visual nit: KMS lock badge tooltip text has low contrast on hover. Options: increase badge size, add inline label 'KMS', or a high-contrast tooltip background.
Mira (Product): on the retention wording — prefer 'Retention period' rather than 'retention_days' in UI copy. Back-end mapping should handle aliases.
Matt (Eng): plan: emit `export_manifest.json` with `export_version`, `headers`, `header_aliases`. Add an opt-in checkbox 'Include key metadata' default OFF. For enterprise orgs, gate with typed-confirm `I understand this export contains key metadata`.
Elaine (Security): +1. Typed confirm required for enterprise. Show short guidance about export destinations and link to policy doc. Log opt-ins.
Aria (A11y): ensure typed input has `aria-describedby` pointing to the security note and SR-friendly validation messages. Modal must trap focus.
Sam (Design): copy suggestions: export button states: 'Download CSV' and 'Download CSV (includes key metadata)'. Tooltip: 'Includes audit fields. Only include key metadata if necessary.'
Matt (Eng): dev ETA: wire manifest + checkbox + feature-flag for typed confirm by EOW. I'll add header_aliasing so UI label changes won't break parsers.
opsbot: deploy-preview created for `feature/audit-export-ux` — http://preview/redwood/5678 (auto)
Mira (Product): thanks all. Owners: Matt (backend), Sam (visuals + copy), Aria (a11y sign-off), Elaine (security copy). I'll file PR checklist and land microcopy tomorrow if no objections.
